sponsor_or_proposer: Chevron (via Noble Energy Cameroon / Noble Energy Equatorial Guinea) operator; Governments of Cameroon & Equatorial Guinea (unitization); New Age holds adjacent Etinde interest
current_state: Cross-border unitization & operating agreement signed 2026-02-06 (Malabo) to jointly develop the Yoyo (Cameroon) / Yolanda (Equatorial Guinea) fields, ~2.5 Tcf. Per the announcements the gas is to be liquefied at Equatorial Guinea's EXISTING Punta Europa LNG complex (backfill; no new terminal), with a secondary axis piping gas to Bipaga in Cameroon for domestic/industrial supply. 2026-07 re-check: no change since the June sweep — no new LNG liquefaction terminal or FLNG sited in Cameroon has been announced.
missing_threshold_elements: No new LNG terminal/facility located IN CAMEROON (liquefaction is at Punta Europa, Equatorial Guinea; the Cameroon leg is a domestic gas pipeline to Bipaga, not an LNG terminal). Concrete step is field-development/unitization, not a Cameroon terminal build.
watch_for: Any decision to site a NEW liquefaction/FLNG facility in Cameroon for Yoyo gas (rather than tolling at Punta Europa in EG); FEED/FID on a Cameroon-located unit; a material change to the in-GEM Etinde FLNG proposal arising from the Cameroon–EG treaty; and (related but separate) any SNH/Perenco announcement of a REPLACEMENT FLNG for the Sanaga gas stream after the Hilli Episeyo departs in July 2026 — a replacement vessel would be an update to the existing Cameroon FLNG record (or a new terminal if a different project), so far none announced.
notes: Carried forward from 2026-06 discovery; re-verified 2026-07 via url_verifier.py PASS on three independent sources: World Oil (best_lead_url), Business in Cameroon (https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/0402-15712-cameroon-equatorial-guinea-agree-on-yoyo-yolanda-gas-unitization-deal), Ecofin Agency (https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-industry/0502-52606-cameroon-e-guinea-sign-agreement-to-jointly-develop-4b-cross-border-gas-field). Etinde FLNG is already in GEM (T100000130913).
